Admin.//: Creates the FIRST administrator. On sign-in, an account whose verified email claim matches this address is granted admin rights - but only while the admins table holds no active administrator. Once one exists this is permanently inert, and further administrators are granted by an existing one. Set it via environment (Admin__BootstrapEmail) rather than here.

Gemini.//: Enriches imported OFO occupations with learner-facing content. Leave ApiKey empty and enrichment is skipped with a clear message rather than failing. Supply it via environment (Gemini__ApiKey) or a secret store, never here.
